drop.description: The rkey of a pet.trezy.foodDrop being consumed by this feed. OPTIONAL: petting carries none, and neither does a feed from the legacy button. ⚠ THE MORSEL IS DELETED ONLY AFTER THE ACTIVITY RECORD HAS SAVED, never before. Deleting first would let a refused feed take the food with it — which the player would experience as theft, with no error anywhere to explain where their morsel went.

error.description: Present instead of uri/createdAt when the interaction was refused for an expected reason. A stable machine code the client branches on — add codes, never rename them. "asleep" means the pet's species is inside one of its published sleep windows — see pet.trezy.gameConfig's sleepWindows. It is reported ahead of "cooldown" when both apply, because a cooldown countdown during a nap sends the player back to be refused again by a rule nobody mentioned.

message.description: A sentence to show the player, accompanying `error`. Free to reword; do not branch on it.
